text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tracen Academy was chosen as a filming location for a movie.
Agnes Tachyon and the other Umamusume are set to appear as extras as well.

text_block_list.name: Film Director
text_block_list.text:
—Alright, and cut!
Thank you all for your cooperation~!
choice_data_list: I can't wait to see what kind of movie it turns out to be.

text_block_list.name: Film Director
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much!
I'll invite everyone to the preview screening!
Please do come and watch it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, a few days later.
We attended the advance screening, but—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Huh? Is the screening going to be delayed?

text_block_list.name: Film Director
text_block_list.text:
Yes, the projector repairs are taking longer than expected...
Still, we can't keep the guests waiting...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Oh dear, what a grave situation this is...!
Thinking of all the effort everyone put in, I can't just overlook this!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
In that case, we shall buy some time!
Trainer, bring the equipment from the lab immediately!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"‘The lot of you’... whoa, hey!
Us too?!"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...What are you scheming?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Nothing at all? I just thought I would take this
opportunity to make a scientific appeal.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hello, everyone!
I'm terribly sorry, but we've run into a bit of trouble.
It seems it'll be a while before we can begin.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Still, worry not!
I shall provide entertainment while we wait!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
A science show harnessing the powers of Umamusume!
Please, enjoy this world brimming with potential to your heart's content!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Now then! First up is an experiment using a floor-power-generation system
to demonstrate the sheer power of our legs!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
The harder you stomp on the floor, the more power it generates
to make the stage lights shine!
Now, you two, give it all you've got and stomp away!

text_block_list.name: Cafe & Dantsu
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
—Whoaa, it's glowing so much I can't see anything!!
—Just how much force is being applied here!?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Next up is the lung capacity experiment!
Behold this microphone, which converts vocal audio
into the exact natural frequency of a glass!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I'll have Pokke-kun use this to shatter
a champagne tower with her voice!
Treat us to the mighty roar of the 'Fierce Roaring Demon'!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Whoaaaa!!" auditions

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (CRASH SMASH SHATTER!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Witnessing the sheer brilliance of the Umamusume, the crowd goes wild! And then—

text_block_list.name: Film Director
text_block_list.text:
"I've finished repairing the projector!
We can start the screening anytime!"
choice_data_list: In that case, give the signal to Tachyon!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
—Kh! Heheheh.
Looks like it's about time.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
And that concludes the show!
However, everyone! Keep your expectations high!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
There are still so many mysteries to Umamusume!
Which means their potential is limitless, you see!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Alright! Finished that off nicely!
Now if she'll just back off...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"—By the way, I happen to be a genius scientist!
And I'm conducting research to dramatically enhance the abilities of Umamusume!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"You just witnessed an Umamusume's true ability!
You want to see its next evolution, don't you? Am I right!?"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Anyone who is interested,
please step forward as a test subject immediately!!"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Could it be that she organized the show
just for that purpose!?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
This is... bad. Her experiments
tend to be quite... something, after all...
choice_data_list: I have to get on stage and stop this!
Let's just play some music and gloss over it.

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
—Hmm, I might actually be a little interested...
—Perhaps I should take part too...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Some of the spectators are starting to notice...! I have to divert their attention somehow!
choice_data_list: Becoming a test subject might cause your body to glow!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
—Eh, it glows...?
—What is that, creepy...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, whoa, Trainer-kun?!
Don't get in my way, pleeease~~!!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
That is my line...
Now, please step back...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Tachyon was dragged away, slithering across the floor.
And so, her recruitment ended in vague ambiguity.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
It's a good idea, but... I don't think
music alone will stop her. Therefore...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
A special service for you, my current test subject!
A selection of hand-picked black tea bags—

text_block_list.name: Pocket & Dantsu
text_block_list.text: "Uuuuu, Umadacchi!"

text_block_list.name: Pocket & Dantsu
text_block_list.text: "Uuuu~! Umapyoi, Umapyoi!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, what are you doing?
The presentation is going to...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
That is my line...
Now, please step back...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Tachyon was dragged away, slithering across the floor.
And so, her recruitment ended in vague ambiguity.
